name: Formosa Prosonic Industries Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司完成两家休眠子公司 Aerotronic Sdn Bhd 与 Energistic Sdn Bhd 的成员自愿清盘，未公告其他业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长66.7%至1.8295亿林吉特，净利润1392.4万林吉特。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed the member's voluntary winding up of two dormant subsidiaries, Aerotronic Sdn Bhd and Energistic Sdn Bhd, with no other announcements on expansion, new business, reduction, or contracts for its business segments. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 66.7% year-on-year to MYR182.95 million, with net profit of MYR13.924 million.
